name: 04_false_start_then_interrupt
description: Adversarial (scripted): 'Uh.' 1 s into the answer must not cut it (at most a duck; Silero often scores a lone 'Uh.' below threshold in-call); 1.5 s later the real 'Wait, wrong order' must cut it. Exactly one barge-in and exactly one new turn.
